messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — I'm Maria (joined today). My calendar shows two "New Hire Orientation" events that overlap (10:00 AM PT and 10:00 AM ET). One of them has no Zoom link or recording in the invite. Which one should I join? Also my calendar is set to Asia/Singapore so times look weird. @Alex P can you advise? :wave:

Alex P: Welcome Maria! :wave: The 10:00 AM PT event is the regional session for US West, the 10:00 AM ET is the global PeopleOps orientation. Both are optional — join the one that matches your team/timezone. The global one should have the Zoom link and recording enabled. I'll look into the invites now.

HR Bot: PeopleOps reminder — Global Orientation starts at 10:00 AM ET. Zoom link is usually in the event description: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/global-2026. Recording will be posted within 1 hour after the session.

Maria Chen: Thanks — I still can't find the link. My invite shows an "Add conferencing" button instead of a Zoom URL. Looks like one invite might have been created without conferencing metadata. Also calendar UI is combining two entries for me.

Samir: I ran into this earlier. Google Calendar sometimes treats a recurring event and a single-instance invite as separate and shows both. Quick workaround: open the event in the web UI -> More actions -> Duplicate, then check the event timezone field and set it explicitly to the session timezone so it doesn't duplicate. Not ideal but works until invites are fixed.

IT Support: Hey all — digging in. It looks like the invite generator used organizer tz=America/Los_Angeles for the regional invite and tz=UTC for the global one. Some clients show both when the invite tz fields differ from the attendee tz. Temporary fix: we can normalize the timezone fields and resend invites with explicit Zoom links. @Alex P, which timezone should be canonical for each event?

Alex P: Confirming: set the global orientation invite timezone to UTC and the regional session to America/Los_Angeles. Add explicit Zoom links and a recording note in the description for both. @IT Support can you resend to the `new-hires-2026` calendar list and include the recording placeholder: "Recording: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/rec123"?

IT Support: Will do — resending invites now with corrected timezone metadata and Zoom links. I also updated the generated ICS to include the conferenceData block so Outlook/Google pick up the link. If you still see duplicates after the new invites arrive, remove both events and re-add from the new invite. Ping me with screenshots and I'll escalate.

Maria Chen: I removed both and re-added the new invite — link is visible and time looks correct now. Thanks so much for the quick help! :thumbsup:

Samir: Same here, everything looks good and recording note is present. Thanks!

HR Bot: Recording will be uploaded to Confluence /onboarding/recordings after the session. If you missed it, watch there or reach out to PeopleOps for a catch-up slot.
